content.text: {"id": "mm6225a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "From 2005 to 2011, significant increases occurred in the annual prevalence of HIV (from 24.6% to 29.4%) and syphilis (from 5.0% to 12.5%)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The incidence of HIV also increased significantly from 2005–2006 to 2011, from 2.8 per 100 PY to 7.9 per 100 PY"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "the prevalence of HIV infection was 28.3% and of all stages of syphilis was 9.8%"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Among those returning for HIV or syphilis testing before the end of 2011, the incidence of HIV infection was 6.3 per 100 person-years"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "the prevalence of HIV infection was 28.3% and of all stages of syphilis was 9.8%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "HIV prevalence was significantly higher among older attendees (29.5% among those aged ≥30 years versus 22.8% for those aged ≤21 years)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "(12.2 per 100 PY for those aged ≤21 years versus 3.2 per 100 PY for those aged ≥30 years)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Among MSM followed at a sexual health clinic in Bangkok, Thailand, during 2005–2011"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "From 2005 to 2011, significant increases occurred in the annual prevalence of HIV (from 24.6% to 29.4%) and syphilis (from 5.0% to 12.5%)."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Trends in HIV prevalence and incidence were evaluated for statistical significance using chi-square and Poisson exact tests."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "HIV and syphilis incidence were computed among those who tested negative for HIV or syphilis at first visit, who returned for testing later."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Poisson exact test was used to evaluate trends in HIV and syphilis incidence; chi-square test for trend was used elsewhere."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
